        r=0
        while r<n:
            if grid[r][c]==5:
                s=r
                while r<n and grid[r][c]==5:r+=1
                mid=(s+r-1)//2
                adjacent=(c>0 and grid[mid][c-1]==5) or (c+1<m and grid[mid][c+1]==5)
                score=(r-s,adjacent)
                if best is None or score>best[0]:best=(score,c,s,r-1)
            else:r+=1
    _,c,s,e=best;r=(s+e)//2
    vertical=(e-s+1==3)
    center_zero=max(range(m),key=lambda j:sum(grid[i][j]==0 for i in range(n)))
    out=[[7]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):out[i][center_zero]=0
    if vertical:

        for i in range(n-1):out[i][c]=5
        out[-1][c]=7;out[r]=[0]*m;out[r][c]=5
    else:

        for j in range(m):out[r][j]=5
        if n>11:out[r][0]=out[r][-1]=7
    return out
